When you have Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I see samples of your cabinet materials before making a decision?

Yes, we have samples of our cabinet materials available for viewing. Feel free to contact us to request samples and see the quality of our materials in person.

What materials do you use for your cabinets?

We use high-quality materials such as solid wood, MDF, and plywood for our cabinets to ensure durability and longevity.

Do you offer installation services for the cabinets?

Yes, we provide professional installation services to ensure that your cabinets are installed correctly and securely.

Can I customize the color and design of my cabinets?

Absolutely! We offer a wide range of color options and designs to suit your preferences and style. Our team will work with you to create custom cabinets that match your vision.

What is the warranty on your cabinets?

We stand behind the quality of our cabinets, and they come with a [insert number]-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
